source: Texas Instruments TPS62130 datasheet F, RGT0016C package drawing and example board layout
pad_center_basis: Page 41 dimensions the perimeter-row centerlines at 2.8 mm, so each row is centered at 1.4 mm from the package origin.
drawing_revision_basis: The outline is identified as RGT0016C; page 41 does not show a separate revision token.
exposed_pad_paste_basis: Page 42 depicts one 1.55 mm square stencil aperture on the 1.68 mm exposed pad, approximately 85% area coverage; the footprint applies a -0.065 mm solder-paste margin instead of creating a window array.
